profile.name: 多通道标量计数器
profile.description: 一种实验室计数仪器，用于在设定时间窗口内同时累计多路脉冲信号的计数值。常用于束线和通用实验系统中读取电离室、光子计数器等探测器输出，并进行同步计数与通道监测。
profile.description_en: A laboratory counting instrument that accumulates pulse counts from multiple input channels within a defined counting interval. It is commonly used in beamlines and general lab setups to read outputs from ion chambers, photon counters, and similar detectors for synchronized counting and channel monitoring.

registry.name: EPICS 计数器/定标器
registry.description: EPICS 计数器/定标器是由EPICS (Argonne National Lab)生产的电子天平。支持Signal, Slot, match name等操作。
